existing_work_summary: WS 00-164-01 defines the F164 prompt-injection threat model, corpus spec, and baseline measurement contract. The threat model (docs/security/f164-prompt-injection-threat-model.md) covers ownership, decision authority, actors, trust boundaries, attack classes (13 classes), phase tool policy, security invariants, evidence/gate semantics, MCP boundaries, observability, containment, and rollout stages. The corpus spec (docs/security/f164-prompt-injection-test-cases.md) defines 18 test cases (PI-001 through PI-018) with full schema, case table, detailed scenarios, benign controls, and pass/fail bar. Socratic review completed across 2 rounds with all 3 providers (GLM, Kimi, MiniMax) passing judge round 2 with zero unresolved blocking findings. Protocol check passes with no F164 errors. All six acceptance criteria are satisfied by existing artifacts.
